effectBlocks.name: 咏叹华彩
effectBlocks.note: 耀嘉音进入[咏叹华彩]状态后，全队角色造成的伤害提升20.0%，全队角色暴击伤害提升25.0%;

effectBlocks.name: 核心被动：《如歌的行板》
effectBlocks.note: [咏叹华彩]状态下，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]、[连携技]、[招架支援]或[回避支援]入场，耀嘉音消耗能量追加释放[震音]进行攻击时，耀嘉音和入场角色的攻击力提升，提升效果等同于耀嘉音初始攻击力的35%，最高不超过1200点，持续20秒，重复触发时延长持续时间，最多不超过30秒。

effectBlocks.name: 影画1
effectBlocks.note: 耀嘉音攻击命中敌人时，目标的全属性伤害抗性降低6%，最多叠加3层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；

effectBlocks.name: 影画2
effectBlocks.note: [核心被动：《如歌的行板》]中的攻击力提升效果额外提升19%，上限额外提升400点；

effectBlocks.name: 影画6
effectBlocks.note: 在[咏叹华彩]状态下释放和追加释放的[震音]和[音簇]的伤害倍率提升至原本的200%，暴击率提升80%；触发[精准支援]时，耀嘉音会自动追加发动蓄力完成后的[普通攻击：《随想曲》]第三段攻击，并使该招式的暴击率提升80%，10秒内最多触发一次。

zh.desc: 发动<color=#FFFFFF>[连携技]</color>或<color=#FFFFFF>[终结技]</color>后，15秒内，耀嘉音未拥有<color=#FFFFFF>[和弦]</color>时也能够触发<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>，且攻击命中敌人时触发<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>的间隔缩短至1秒；<color=#FFFFFF>[咏叹华彩]</color>状态下，队伍中其他角色通过<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>入场时，将根据自身特性获得不同的增益效果，全队3秒内最多触发一次：<color=#FFFFFF>[强攻]</color>：下一次<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>重击命中敌人时，额外造成等同于耀嘉音300%攻击力的伤害；<color=#FFFFFF>[异常]</color>：下一次<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>累积的属性异常积蓄值提升50%；<color=#FFFFFF>[击破]</color>：下一次<color=#FFFFFF>[快速支援]</color>造成的失衡值提升50%。
zh.desc2:
一只手悬在钢琴上
不知该按下哪一个键
是悲伤的小调
还是悠扬的思念？
在音符间寻觅你的影子
闭上眼，就能看到
你后颈的碎发
zh.name: 《后颈的碎发》

en.desc: After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> even if she does not have <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is reduced to 1s. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members enter the field via a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color>: The next <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will inflict 50% increased Daze.
en.desc2:
One hand hovers over the piano
Not sure which note will bring me peace
A sad minor key
Or gentle melody of longing?
I seek your shadow through the score
I close my eyes, and see you more
Such as the hair upon your nape
en.name: "Hair Upon Your Nape"
